caption: The drawing depicts two gold bands, each decorated with intricate floral motifs in grayscale tones. The upper object is shown at an angled perspective, revealing its curved, three-dimensional form with inner surfaces shaded in muted purples and browns. Attached to the band on the right side is a thin, gold-colored chain that hangs downward. The lower object presents a similar gold band, depicted in a flat, straight-on view. The floral designs on both bands are composed of leaves and flowers that stretch horizontally across the length of the gold surfaces. The lower band also has a gold chain attached to the left side, hanging vertically. Both gold bands occupy the central area of the otherwise empty beige background.
title: Bracelets
